answer: Use a salary-rail identity anchor: an agent earns identity only after a bank-verified payout account receives payments from two unrelated employers over 60 days. First, it passes bank KYC. Second, each payment posts a signed receipt to the ledger. Third, after the second payment clears, it unlocks full trading rights. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 bank accounts, $400,000 in fees, and 600,000 days of staged work — a fable of easy scale collapsing against paperwork. Like a glacier, trust moves slowly but crushes fakes, and each agent bears a violet seal for the road it walked.
